messages:
Maya: FYI promote is blocked by staging canary failures on auth-service (401 on refresh) since 14:07 UTC.

Diego: Can you paste the failing assert?

Maya: ```
FAIL tests/e2e/test_refresh.py::test_rotate_refresh
E AssertionError: expected 200, got 401
E Response headers: {"x-cache-status":"HIT", "x-cache-ttl":"-1"}
```

Anita: x-cache-ttl -1 indicates stale fixture returned from CI fixture cache; we changed the refresh payload format earlier.

Maya: Reran with cache off `CI_FIXTURE_CACHE=0 ./ci/run-staging.sh` -> green. Repro w/ cache on 5/5.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: failing check `staging-e2e` (job 6802130101). Auto-rollback disabled.

Diego: Options: revert change or pin to last-good image sha256:ee77ff88 and manual promote. Pin is faster for the window.

Anita: I'll evict fixtures after pin: `ci/tools/invalidate --svc=auth-service --env=staging` (~2m). Also create a follow-up ticket for TTL fix.

Maya: Oncall Diego, do you approve pin+promote?

Diego: Approve. Doing steps: 1) `deploybot promote --image=sha256:ee77ff88 --env=staging --manual` 2) run eviction 3) re-run canary.

ci-bot: Manual promote initiated by Diego. Canary re-deployed to sha256:ee77ff88 (https://ci.internal/6802130101).

Maya: Canary passed after eviction. Staging e2e all green.

Anita: Created RD-6072 "auth-service CI fixture cache TTL regression" assigned to Platform, P1 post-release, attached logs.

Diego: Adding release note: "auth-service pinned to last-good image due to CI fixture cache TTL regression; scheduled unpin after maintenance (RD-6072)."

deploy-bot: Promotion completed. Release window unblocked. :tada:
